title: SM64DS Co-op preview.2: internet input and castle softlock repair

tests: Native menu, 42 binding-cell hit targets, mixed input capture, distinct S/5, chat, palette and fullscreen checks
Actual game Speed & Coordinates HUD launch and exact 20.12 coordinate fixture

Two clients with HUD enabled, 180 ms one-way delay, 60 ms jitter, 2% packet loss; host online through joined-client timing window; 29.93/30.08 ticks/sec, zero buffered input and castle re-entry passed

notes: Sharper antialiased menu/chat/player-name text, high-resolution title menus with gameplay resolution restored, all 14 controls with three mixed binding boxes, and optional Speed & Coordinates HUD for solo and online. Original cartridge artwork retains its DS style. Enable the HUD from Mods before entering a room. Existing immediate-input and castle-entry fixes retained. Separate peer-departure tests showed intermittent pacing pauses under investigation; this is not a seven-PC internet certification. Native Linux/SteamOS and macOS work follows this release; no native game packages are claimed.
